## How do I connect an AI model?

<a id="connect-ai"></a>

Open AI & Automation and pick one of two choices: a free model on this computer (nothing leaves your PC), or your ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan (sign in in your browser; no API key and no extra bill). You can use both.

**Where:** **Setup › AI & Automation** (`/ai-settings`)

1. Open AI & Automation (Company > AI & Automation). → **Setup › AI & Automation** (`/ai-settings`)
2. Free, on this computer: click "Set up free AI on this computer". On Windows Ironbooks installs Ollama, downloads a starter model and connects it.
3. Your subscription: click "Continue with ChatGPT" and sign in in your browser. Then turn on "Allow cloud AI for this company".
4. Click "Test connection". Ask AI and the automatic suggestions now use your model.

> Good to know: With both set up, the local model answers first and ChatGPT takes over when it cannot.
>
> Good to know: Other services (Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Azure OpenAI, any OpenAI-compatible server) are under "Add AI…" with an API key, billed by that service per use.
>
> Good to know: A model on another computer of yours: "Find models on other computers (Tailscale)".

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I connect an AI model?", or ask Ask AI.*

## What can I ask Ask AI?

<a id="ask-ai"></a>

Click Ask AI in the top bar and ask in plain words. It answers questions about your numbers from your own reports, tells you how to do something and links to the screen, and can draft an entry for you to approve. It never changes your books on its own.

**Where:** **Ask AI** (`/dashboard?assistant=1`)

1. Numbers: "How did we do this month?", "Who owes us money?", "What is our cash balance?". Each figure names the report it came from.
2. How-to: "How do I reconcile my bank account?", "Where do I enter a bill?". The answer comes with a button that opens the screen.
3. Recording: "Record a $120 bill from Office Supply Co for supplies". It prepares a bill, invoice, payment or journal entry and shows it for you to Approve or Reject.

> Good to know: Without a connected model Ask AI still gives basic answers from your reports and the built-in guide.
>
> Good to know: With a cloud model, listed names and identifiers are hidden before anything is sent.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "What can I ask Ask AI?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I let AI categorize bank transactions, and check what it did?

<a id="ai-auto-categorize"></a>

Ironbooks learns how you categorize. It can add the bank lines it is confident about on its own, and you can see and undo every one.

**Where:** **Setup › AI & Automation** (`/ai-settings`)

1. Open AI & Automation. Under Automation, turn "Auto-categorize confident bank-feed transactions" on or off and set the Confidence threshold. → **Setup › AI & Automation** (`/ai-settings`)
2. Open "What the AI posted" to see every line it added, and undo any of them. → **What the AI posted** (`/ai-posts`)
3. Lines below the threshold wait for you in Review bank transactions. → **Banking › Review bank transactions** (`/bank-review`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I let AI categorize bank transactions, and check what it did?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I have my books checked for mistakes?

<a id="error-review"></a>

Error Review looks for unbalanced, duplicate and miscategorized entries and other common problems, and explains how to fix each one.

**Where:** **Reports › Error Review** (`/errors`)

1. Open Error Review. → **Reports › Error Review** (`/errors`)
2. Open an issue to read the Analysis, the "Steps to resolve" and the "Impact if unresolved".
3. Fix it where it says, or apply the suggested correction when one is offered.

> Good to know: Data Integrity proves the ledger itself balances: see "How do I check that my data is sound?".

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I have my books checked for mistakes?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I enter things by typing a sentence?

<a id="command-bar"></a>

Press Ctrl+K and type what you want, such as "invoice Acme 3 hours consulting". The form opens filled in for you to check. Nothing is saved without you.

1. Press Ctrl+K anywhere.
2. Type the task: "invoice Acme 3 hours consulting", "show unpaid bills over 60 days", "what did we spend on fuel in Q3?".
3. Check the form that opens and save it yourself.

> Good to know: Common phrases work with no AI model. Sentences the command bar does not recognize are passed to your connected model.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I enter things by typing a sentence?", or ask Ask AI.*
